video.title: Analysis of Conflict AI Kickoff - Phase 0-20260527_130151-Meeting Recording

key_points.point: Dask Technology operates in the automotive SaaS space
key_points.details: Dask Technology provides multiple SaaS solutions for the automotive industry, including media/advertisement services for car dealerships, lead response services, and reputation management

key_points.point: Daniel Aston is SVP of Engineering at Dask
key_points.details: Daniel Aston has been with Dask for over 6 years and has 13-15 years of engineering experience, transitioning from coding to management

key_points.point: Alex English is SVP of Product at Dask
key_points.details: Alex English has been with Dask for 14 years with operational background in account management, support, onboarding, and deactivations; has led product team for 4 years

key_points.point: Mike Paylor is a technology and product consultant
key_points.details: Mike Paylor has worked with Dask for 3 years and known them for 13 years; has VP of Engineering and CTO experience at PayPal, Upwork, and startups; focusing on infrastructure, DevOps, and cost savings

key_points.point: Leo is the project leader and coordinator
key_points.details: Leo has 20+ years in tech with experience in ops, data, coding, AI, and cloud infrastructure; serving as central coordinator for the project

key_points.point: Conflict team includes multiple engineers with diverse experience
key_points.details: Team includes Luis Hernandez (30 years distributed systems), Alicia (20+ years data engineering), Oscar (13+ years software development), Byron (8 years experience), Hiram (full stack engineer), Julio (8 years full stack), and Craig Irwin (commercial lead)

key_points.point: Project goal is to build a CDP (Customer Data Platform)
key_points.details: Dask Technology is planning to implement a Customer Data Platform to consolidate data silos across their various automotive SaaS applications

key_points.point: Dask has developed data silos across multiple applications
key_points.details: Throughout 15 years of operation, Dask has created separate sources of record across different applications, despite having a data lake and reporting engine

key_points.point: Meeting agenda focuses on scope alignment and discovery
key_points.details: Discussion will cover purpose, objectives, duration, data sharing, access requirements, and guiding questions; Leo has a hard stop after 50 minutes

key_points.point: Initial discovery phase to understand goals and requirements
key_points.details: Team will discuss what they're building, why, and what success looks like before diving into technical details and data sharing requirements
